title: Translations
subtitle: One module per language pointing to verified open-source translation resources from reputable venues, with a SeamlessM4T v2 speech-to-text fallback where the language is supported.

modules.verification_policy: Human verification recommended for any low/very-low-resource output before client delivery.

recommended_resources.name: OPUS-MT (opus-mt-tc-big-en-fr)
recommended_resources.venue: Tiedemann & Thottingal, EAMT 2020 (aclanthology.org/2020.eamt-1.61); Tiedemann et al., LRE 2023
recommended_resources.offline: Lightweight per-pair Marian-NMT model — among the best for offline mobile.
recommended_resources.notes: Permissive licence (commercial OK). Reverse direction model also exists.

recommended_resources.name: MADLAD-400-3B-MT
recommended_resources.offline: GGUF 2–4-bit quantization brings the 3B model under ~1–2 GB.
recommended_resources.notes: Permissive licence (commercial OK). Prefix input with <2xx> target token.

recommended_resources.name: NLLB-200 (distilled 600M)
recommended_resources.offline: Convert to CTranslate2 / quantize (int8) for low-RAM phones.
recommended_resources.notes: Strong low-resource coverage; non-commercial licence.

resources.name: SeamlessM4T v2 (large)
resources.modality: speech+text (ASR, speech→text translation, S2ST, T2ST, T2TT)
resources.offline: Large multimodal model (~2B+); run server-side or quantize/prune for device. Heavier than text-only MT.
resources.notes: Speech recognition + speech translation across ~100 languages; non-commercial licence.

speech_to_text.note: SeamlessM4T v2 supports French speech (ASR + speech translation).

modules.integration_notes: High quality and abundant. For commercial use prefer OPUS-MT or MADLAD-400.

modules.verification_policy: Human verification recommended for any low/very-low-resource output before client delivery.

recommended_resources.name: Kreyòl-MT
recommended_resources.license: Model fine-tuned from mBART-50; dataset licence: 'other' (see card)
recommended_resources.offline: Many-to-many mBART-50 fine-tune; dataset = largest public Creole MT corpus (11.6M public sentences).
recommended_resources.notes: Strongest dedicated Haitian Creole option (purpose-built for creoles).

recommended_resources.name: NLLB-200 (distilled 600M)
recommended_resources.offline: Convert to CTranslate2 / quantize (int8) for low-RAM phones.
recommended_resources.notes: Strong low-resource coverage; non-commercial licence.

recommended_resources.name: MADLAD-400-3B-MT
recommended_resources.offline: GGUF 2–4-bit quantization brings the 3B model under ~1–2 GB.
recommended_resources.notes: Permissive licence (commercial OK). Prefix input with <2xx> target token.

speech_to_text.note: Not in SeamlessM4T v2. Haitian Creole is lexically close to French; a French ASR can give a rough first pass, but verify with a fluent speaker. SeamlessM4T v2 does NOT list this language. Use the text pipeline with human transcription of voice notes, or a community ASR model verified before use.

modules.integration_notes: Lexically close to French; French pivot works well as a fallback.

modules.verification_policy: Human verification recommended for any low/very-low-resource output before client delivery.

recommended_resources.name: Kreyòl-MT
recommended_resources.license: Model fine-tuned from mBART-50; dataset licence: 'other' (see card)
recommended_resources.offline: Many-to-many mBART-50 fine-tune; dataset = largest public Creole MT corpus (11.6M public sentences).
recommended_resources.notes: Kreyòl-MT's language set includes Garifuna (cab) — the most reputable (peer-reviewed) option found.

recommended_resources.name: garifuna-nllb (community fine-tune of NLLB-200 600M)
recommended_resources.venue: Hugging Face model hub (community-contributed, not peer-reviewed)
recommended_resources.license: Declared MIT on the model card (NOTE: base NLLB-200 is CC-BY-NC-4.0 — verify compatibility)
recommended_resources.offline: Fine-tuned NLLB 600M checkpoint; quantize for device use.
recommended_resources.notes: Trilingual ES/EN/Garifuna. Experimental (~12 downloads/month). Evaluate quality and confirm licence before any paid use.

speech_to_text.note: Not in SeamlessM4T v2 and no known robust open Garifuna ASR. Use human transcription of voice notes. SeamlessM4T v2 does NOT list this language. Use the text pipeline with human transcription of voice notes, or a community ASR model verified before use.

modules.integration_notes: Very low-resource: not in NLLB-200 / MADLAD-400 core sets. Treat machine output as draft-only with mandatory verification by fluent speakers. Building a small verified Garifuna corpus is itself Income Module 3 / 12 in the app.

resources.offline: Research ASR system; not a packaged mobile model.
